text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser gets injured during training, so I bring her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sorry for worrying you. It doesn't seem like that big a deal, though.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Let's head back to the track.
choice_data_list: You're really planning to run again already?
You're really planning to run again already?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's fine! I mean, sure, my nose might bleed, I could break into a fever, or even hives… But I just know I've got more energy than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Plus, I can't just sit around resting while everyone else is out there working!
choice_data_list: Right now, what you need to do is rest.
All right, so long as we keep it reasonable.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I had a feeling you'd say that…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But it's times like these that I have to work hard, or I'll just stay ordinary forever…
choice_data_list: If you're not healthy, you can't be a star, let alone ordinary.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right, I'll get plenty of rest today so that my injury heals faster.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser sounds slightly disappointed, but she returns to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll be nice and careful while I run!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ugh… The injury from earlier is hurting again… I guess I got a little ahead of myself…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm really sorry, Trainer, but I guess I'm going to have to pack it up for the day…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser sounds regretful, but returns to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew… I think I can do this as long as I don't go all out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right, let's go! I'll keep things reasonable, just like you said! Mun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser stays mindful of her injury and trains comfortably within her limits.
